logger.doc:name: Before Retrieve Sales Details from DB

db:select.doc:name: Retrieve Sales Details from DB
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sales.transaction_id,sales.source,sales.customer_name,sales.delivery_address,sales.customer_contact, sales.customer_age,sales.customer_gender,sales.total_amount,sales.payment_type,sales.transaction_date, items.item_id,items.product_name,items.price,items.quantity FROM sales INNER JOIN sales_items items ON sales.transaction_id = items.transaction_id WHERE sales.transaction_id = :transaction_id;
